[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Faction Glossary[/color][/head]
Taypan is fought over by powers with different sources of legitimacy: charter, revolution, contract, kinship, and local jurisdiction. The pages below explain the four largest organizations and their chains of command.
[head=3][color=#684871]Divine Sol Mandate (DSM)[/color][/head] Count Olywier's feudal-commercial charter: nobles, burghers, Saintsworn, Freeholders, and Oathbound subjects under Imperial law. See [textlink="DSM" link="GlossaryDSM"].
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]New Crescent Workers' League (NCWL)[/color][/head] The provisional revolutionary front backed by secure Workers' Union territory in Chengridz. See [textlink="NCWL" link="GlossaryNCWL"].
[head=3][color=#535961]Shinohara Heavy Industries (SHI)[/color][/head] An integrated corporate power that turns infrastructure, standards, credit, and continuity into leverage. See [textlink="Shinohara" link="GlossarySHI"].
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Taypani Free Companies Federation (TFCF)[/color][/head] GSC, Interdyne, Cyberdawn, and SAW joined under an Administrator for Federation-wide matters while retaining internal control. See [textlink="TFCF" link="GlossaryTFSC"].
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Other powers[/color][/head] The Taypani-Atyrian Pact survives through four mobile family networks. Gliess Santo enforces the King's Articles and inherits Colonial Minutemen law. The Saint's Militia is one extremist movement with four doctrinal currents.
For a quick reference on titles and honorifics, see [textlink="Forms of Address" link="FormsOfAddress"].
